incidents.title: Eni presses ahead with Egypt gas projects as war raises investment risks
incidents.blurb: Egyptian President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi met with Eni CEO Claudio Descalzi on Tuesday, with the Italian energy giant revealing it could make a crucial investment decision in coming months.

incidents.title: Top EU court says Kavala case exposes erosion of judicial independence in Turkey
incidents.blurb: Europe's top human rights court has renewed its call for Turkey to immediately release jailed philanthropist Osman Kavala, saying his imprisonment reflects a broader “systemic problem” over independence and impartiality of the judiciary.

incidents.title: Iraq's Zaidi set to make European debut with Macron in France
incidents.blurb: The Iraqi prime minister is expected to sign several memorandums of understanding with France during his Sept. 14 meeting with Macron as Baghdad seeks to diversify its diplomatic and security ties.

incidents.title: Trump says Hormuz mine-free as Iran, Oman agree to clear them
incidents.blurb: The US president again says Hormuz is clear of mines as Iran and Oman announce their plan to clear the strait.

incidents.title: Turkey’s Kurdish peace process moves to implementation: What to know and what’s next
incidents.blurb: Turkey’s peace process with Kurdish militants has entered the implementation phase this week, with authorities setting up working groups to verify the Kurdistan Workers Party’s disarmament.
